# Doit Then 1.0
- Refine calendar event editing, date/time controls, and calendar preferences. - Add configurable default task duration with presets and custom durations. - Add persistent previous/next calendar controls and unified drag-edge navigation. - Add fast direct Day/Week event resizing from the bottom edge with 15-minute snapping. - Move the detailed calendar inspector to right-click and simplify left-click selection. - Improve calendar drag/drop behavior, visual stability, Undo/Redo, and scheduling interactions.
